blocking.title: R178 regresses R174 / ADR-1135 (a): on a phone the war row cuts a name under 5 letters while the '& n' stays ('Sovi… & 3' at 375 x 667; 'Que…' for Queensland at 390 x 844 on the random world)
blocking.evidence: c82_nameLetters.mjs 68901 400 375x667 on HEAD: 'Sovi… & 3 ⚔ Japan & 6' (critic/shots/c82nl_68901_d400_375x667_5405_row.png); run 81's build 'Soviet Un…' (critic/shots/c82nl_68901_d400_375x667_5406_row.png). 82901 day 400 at 375 x 667: 'Sovi… & 3', the row 10 px past its width and '+5' cut at the screen's edge (critic/c82_bf_82901_400_375_667_5405.log). SCEN=random c81_bannerFit 64965 730 390 844: 'Alaska ⚔ Que…' (3 letters) on HEAD, 'Queen…' on run 81's build (critic/shots/c81bf_random_64965_d730_390x844_c82_540[56]_row.png). c81_bannerFit reports 0 faults on these because the line clamp keeps scrollWidth equal to clientWidth; the shots show the cut. The name's box is 34 px on HEAD against 51 px on run 81's build (68901 d400 375, the probes' geometry). Contradicts ADR-1135 (a) ('a longer one keeps 6 ch (its first five letters and the ellipsis)'; the score, then the '& n', give way first), R178's own style.css comment ('gives way before a name goes under five letters') and R178's ROADMAP note ('0 overflow' on 68901 d400 at 375; 'random 64965 at 390' clean).
blocking.fix: Let '& n' give way per banner before a name goes under 5 letters (not by the row's 350 px container width alone), or widen the container bound over the 366-400 px rows; keep the clamp's break at a word, not overflow-wrap:anywhere. Seen fixed when the row shots of c82_nameLetters 68901 400 368x740,375x667,384x832 and 82901 400 375x667, and of SCEN=random c81_bannerFit 64965 730 390 844, show every long name with 5 or more letters before its ellipsis or whole ('Queen…' or more), c81_bannerFit 82901 400 375 667 shows no overflow and '+n' inside the view, and the 320, 360, 390 and 412 px 1938 cases stay as now.
